company.description:
We believe that the best and most successful people are 'students' of their fields who are find happiness in the constant pursuit of growth, professionally and personally - a lifelong learner. The faster the world around us changes, the more important it is to be a lifelong learner in order to stay competitive.

Lifelong learning comprises four soft skills (Communication, Critical Thinking, Collaboration, Creativity) and four mindset attributes (Curiosity, Initiative, Persistence, Adaptability). All of these are relevant across disciplines and professions.

Gentem Indonesia Lifelong Learning (GILL) Group's mission is to cultivate lifelong learning from an early age in order to increase the competitiveness of Indonesians. GILL delivers premium, efficacious learning outcomes through exclusive partnerships with world-leading content providers and is heavily technology-enabled under separately branded businesses - Wall Street English, Genstarkids, and INDIES (Independent International Education Solutions).

GILL Group was established with the acquisition of the Wall Street English Indonesia business in 2016 and now has over 5,000 active members learning online and in-center across its 11 locations. Genstarkids was launched in October 2025 with the first studio in Bintaro and the second in Cikarang. INDIES was soft-launched in June 2024.

GILL also provides IELTS test prep courses as well as business english courses (professional skills) to both retail and corporate customers. Our corporate customers include blue-chip multinational companies as well as large local conglomerates.

description:
🌟 We're Hiring: Personal Assistant to CEO 🌟

This is a full-time on-site role for an Executive Personal Assistant to the Founder & Chief Executive Officer of the Gentem Group. The Executive Personal Assistant will be responsible for providing personal and administrative support to executives, managing communication, maintaining diaries, and demonstrating strong clerical skills on a daily basis. This role sits at the heart of a fast-paced and dynamic environment, requiring adaptability, proactivity, and a high level of professionalism to support the demands of executive leadership.

✨ What You’ll Do

  • Keep the Chief Executive Officer's schedule running like clockwork, from meeting coordination to travel arrangements.
  • Ensure important decisions and action items don't fall through the cracks.
  • Handle sensitive correspondence and prepare materials that reflect our professional standards.
  • Coordinate logistics including transportation and daily operations.
  • Manage expense tracking, reimbursements, and administrative processes.

🎉 Why Join Our Team

  • Career Growth: Real growth opportunities in a company that believes in promoting from within.
  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: Competitive pay, health insurance, and other perks.
  • A High Performance Culture: A culture where ambition meets purpose.
  • Collaborative Work Environment: Work alongside people who are passionate about education and innovation.

🌍 About Gentem

At Gentem Indonesia Lifelong Learning, we empower people through education, opening doors to new opportunities. As the parent company of Wall Street English Indonesia, Genstarkids, and Indies, we uphold the values of Family, Integrity, and Excellence, fostering a culture of collaboration, trust, and outstanding results. Committed to lifelong learning, we create opportunities for growth at every stage of life. If you’re passionate about making an impact, you’ll fit right in.

💪 Ready to amplify your impact?
Apply now and help us turn educational vision into reality.

qualifications:
🛠️What Makes You Right for This Role

  • You're the person everyone counts on to remember everything and keep things organized.
  • You approach challenges with logical thinking and structured problem solving.
  • You can juggle multiple priorities without dropping the ball.
  • You communicate with clarity and confidence at all levels.
  • You handle confidential information with absolute discretion.
  • You solve problems before they become issues.
  • Fluent in English (written & verbal)
  • Diary Management proficiency
  • Strong attention to detail and perfectionist
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to handle confidential information with integrity
  • Comfortable in a high-pressure, fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Proficiency in MS Office and other relevant software
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in a similar role is a prerequisite
